resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and firelookout.com give 1969 for the cab. firelookout.com's Antrim Point page says an R-6 cab replaced an L-4 cab there in 1968. The record and story keep 1969; the 1968 date is left as an open conflict.
NHLR and firelookout.com describe a 10-foot concrete base; Forest Lookouts says cinder block. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: NHLR, firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts agree on the 1969 cab, the 1974 move from Antrim Point and the staffing. Open conflicts: 1968 vs 1969 for the Antrim Point cab (firelookout.com Antrim page) and concrete vs cinder block base. height_m 3.0 is proposed for removal because it equals the base height. Access set to restricted as an inference from 'regularly staffed'; no source states visitor rules, so verify with the West Fork Ranger District. Staffing as_of is the read date because the NHLR text is undated. 'Still stands' is cited to the Antrim Point page (cite 4), because the Lookout Mountain pages say only that it is staffed. The NHLR rentals page read did not list this lookout. No fire history found in the sources read. No photos added: firelookout.com credits the Fire Lookout Museum and Gary Weber but gives no image URLs.
